title: Astrology Days
tagline: A friend runs a record label. I built the ticket site for its live show.
what: A small ticket site for a live show. You reserve tickets, pay by Venmo, and get a ticket page that gets stamped PAID once they confirm it. On the night, whoever's at the door checks people in from a list on their phone.
built: Reserve, then pay: phones get an Open Venmo button, computers get a QR code of the same link
A door list made for a phone: search, one-tap check-in, walk-ups, and a PDF to email anyone
Paid tickets get a red PAID stamp on their page and a receipt by email
Google-only sign-in for the back office, and new people wait until an admin lets them in
Code that splits the show photo into two ink layers, so it looks like a two-colour print
credit: Built it on the bones of my Chunky sign-up site

making.problem: A friend's record label was selling tickets for a show through a generic online form and wanted something less janky.
how: You reserve tickets and get a ticket page with a short code
You pay by Venmo with the amount and a note already filled in
They mark it paid, and your page gets the PAID stamp
At the door, a list on a phone with one-tap check-in
credits: Venmo handles the money and Google handles sign-in
The show, the music and the photos are the label's

moment.what: I built the whole thing in one day, Sep 25: ten rounds of changes, from the first page to emailing the door list as a PDF.
